MAM12 数学方法/U3 · 微分进阶与应用/指数函数求导：e 的引入 lim: e is the only base for which lim(h→0)(aʰ−1)/h equals 1, hence d/dx(eˣ)=eˣ; by the chain rule d/dx(e^(kx))=k·e^(kx), and in the model A·e^(kt) a positive k gives growth while a negative k gives decay. Common error: assuming d/dx(aˣ)=aˣ for any base (it should be aˣ·ln a).
MAM12 数学方法/U3 · 微分进阶与应用/三角函数求导：d/dx(sin: d/dx(sin x)=cos x and d/dx(cos x)=−sin x hold in radian measure and can be derived from graphs, numerical approximation and a geometric construction; when the inner function is kx, the chain rule gives d/dx(sin kx)=k·cos kx. Common errors: dropping the minus sign on cos, or applying the derivative formulas in degree mode.
MAM12 数学方法/U3 · 微分进阶与应用/求导法则：乘积法则、商法则、链式: Product rule d/dx(uv)=u′v+uv′; quotient rule d/dx(u/v)=(u′v−uv′)/v², where the order in the numerator cannot be swapped; chain rule d/dx f(g(x))=f′(g(x))·g′(x), and for f(ax−b) the outer derivative must also be multiplied by a. Identify the structure before choosing a formula — mixing up the three is the classic way to lose marks.
MAM12 数学方法/U3 · 微分进阶与应用/二阶导数：作为变化率的变化率、加: Differentiating the derivative once more gives the second derivative, meaning 'the rate of change of the rate of change'; differentiating position s(t) gives velocity and differentiating again gives acceleration. f″(x)>0 means the slope is increasing. Note that f′(x)=0 gives stationary points while f″(x)=0 only gives candidates for points of inflection — the two are usually not the same set of points.
MAM12 数学方法/U3 · 微分进阶与应用/增量公式 δy ≈ f′(x)·: Approximate with the tangent instead of the curve: δy ≈ f′(x)·δx, that is, a small change in the function is approximately the derivative times the change in the independent variable, and the smaller δx is the more accurate this is. It is commonly used to estimate changes in and errors of powers, surds or trigonometric values, and can also be worked backwards from an allowable error to find the tolerance on δx. The assumption is that δx is small enough — otherwise the deviation is noticeable.
MAM12 数学方法/U3 · 微分进阶与应用/凹凸性与拐点；二阶导数判别法判定: f″(x)>0 means the curve is concave up and f″(x)<0 means concave down, and where f″ changes sign there is a point of inflection. Second derivative test: when f′(c)=0, f″(c)<0 gives a local maximum and f″(c)>0 gives a local minimum; when f″(c)=0 the test is inconclusive and you must go back to the sign table for the first derivative. Do not mistake a point of inflection for an extremum.
MAM12 数学方法/U3 · 微分进阶与应用/用一、二阶导数求驻点与拐点并作图: Order for sketching: use f′ to find stationary points and determine their nature, use f″ to determine concavity intervals and points of inflection, then add intercepts and end behaviour. For optimisation, define variables first, write down the objective function and the constraint, eliminate to a single variable, differentiate and set to zero, and finally you must justify whether it is a maximum or a minimum using the second derivative or by comparing endpoints. Forgetting the domain and forgetting to 'prove the extremum' are the easiest ways to lose marks.
MAM12 数学方法/U3 · 积分 Integrals/反导数（不定积分）：∫: Antidifferentiation is the reverse of differentiation, and the result is a family of functions, so +c must be written. The basic formulas come from reversing the derivative table: ∫xⁿdx=xⁿ⁺¹/(n+1)+c (n≠−1), ∫eˣdx=eˣ+c, ∫sin x dx=−cos x+c, ∫cos x dx=sin x+c. Common errors: omitting c; applying the power formula to n=−1 as well.
MAM12 数学方法/U3 · 积分 Integrals/∫f(ax−b)dx: When the inner function is linear you can simply 'divide by the coefficient': ∫f(ax−b)dx=(1/a)F(ax−b)+c, because differentiating back brings out a through the chain rule. Antidifferentiation is also linear, so constants can be taken out and sums and differences split into separate terms. Note that this trick only works for a linear inner function such as ax−b; it cannot be copied across to an inner function like x².
MAM12 数学方法/U3 · 积分 Integrals/曲线族：由 f′(x): Knowing f′(x) and one initial condition determines a unique antiderivative: integrate first to get the general solution with constant c, then substitute f(a)=b and solve for c. Geometrically the general solution is a family of curves of the same shape shifted vertically, and the initial condition picks out one of them. Common mistakes: setting c=0 first and then solving, or leaving c out of the final answer.
MAM12 数学方法/U3 · 积分 Integrals/定积分：Σf(xᵢ)δ: Divide [a,b] into n subintervals and use Σf(xᵢ)δxᵢ to find the sum of the rectangle areas, then let n→∞ and δx→0; the limit of that sum is the definite integral. Left-endpoint, right-endpoint and midpoint rectangles give different approximations, and the larger n is the closer they come to the true value. The result is a number, with no +c.
MAM12 数学方法/U3 · 积分 Integrals/定积分作为曲线下面积；: A definite integral is the signed area between the curve and the x-axis: positive above the axis and negative below it. To find a 'total area' you must first locate the zeros and split into subintervals, then integrate each piece and add the absolute values; to find the area between two curves you integrate 'upper minus lower'. The most common error is treating a straight integral as an area and ignoring the negative sign below the x-axis.
MAM12 数学方法/U3 · 积分 Integrals/微积分基本定理：F′(: If F′(x)=f(x), then ∫ₐᵇf′(x)dx=f(b)−f(a), which turns a definite integral into 'find an antiderivative, substitute the limits'; the other form d/dx∫ₐˣf(t)dt=f(x) shows that integrating and then differentiating returns the original function. When substituting, the order of the limits cannot be swapped, and the +c of the antiderivative cancels automatically in the subtraction.
MAM12 数学方法/U3 · 积分 Integrals/积分应用：由变化率求总: Integrating a rate of change gives the total change: ∫ₐᵇR′(t)dt=R(b)−R(a); integrating velocity gives displacement, integrating speed |v| gives distance travelled, and integrating acceleration together with initial conditions gives velocity and position. To find the area between curves, first find the points of intersection to fix the limits and decide which curve is on top. Typical trap: treating displacement as distance travelled, and failing to split the integral where velocity changes sign.
MAM12 数学方法/U3 · 离散随机变量/离散随机变量与概率函数；用相对频率: A discrete random variable takes only countably many values, and its probability function requires every probability to lie between 0 and 1 with the total equal to 1 — this condition is often used to find an unknown constant k. With no theoretical model, use relative frequencies from a large data set as a point estimate of the probability. Be careful not to confuse P(X=x) with the cumulative probability P(X≤x).
MAM12 数学方法/U3 · 离散随机变量/均匀离散分布与非均匀离散分布: In a uniform discrete distribution all values are equally likely, so with n values in total each probability is 1/n, which suits symmetric settings such as dice and spinners; in a non-uniform distribution the values have different probabilities and these must be listed one by one. The test is whether the probabilities are equal, not whether the gaps between the values are equal.
MAM12 数学方法/U3 · 离散随机变量/期望值/均值（位置度量）、方差与标: The expected value E(X)=Σx·P(X=x) measures the centre of the distribution and is the long-run average; the variance Var(X)=E(X²)−[E(X)]² or Σ(x−μ)²P(X=x), and the standard deviation is its square root, measuring spread and carrying the same units as X. In the exam you can use the calculator's statistics functions to evaluate these. Common errors: writing μ² for the variance, or forgetting to take the square root.
MAM12 数学方法/U3 · 离散随机变量/线性变换 Y=aX+b 对均值与标: For Y=aX+b: E(Y)=aE(X)+b, σ_Y=|a|σ_X and Var(Y)=a²Var(X). So the translation b only shifts the centre without changing the spread, while the scaling by a changes the mean and the standard deviation by the same factor. Common errors: forgetting the absolute value for the standard deviation, and forgetting to square for the variance.
MAM12 数学方法/U3 · 离散随机变量/Bernoulli 分布：适用情境: A trial with only two outcomes (success/failure) in which the probability of success is always p follows a Bernoulli distribution, with mean p, variance p(1−p) and standard deviation √(p(1−p)). It is the special case of the binomial distribution with n=1. To recognise the setting, hold to three points: the outcome is binary, the probability is fixed, and the trial is done once.
MAM12 数学方法/U3 · 离散随机变量/二项分布：P(X=x)=C(n,x: In n independent repeated Bernoulli trials the number of successes X follows a binomial distribution: P(X=x)=C(n,x)pˣ(1−p)ⁿ⁻ˣ, with mean np and variance np(1−p). For 'at most/at least' questions you can use cumulative probabilities. Common error: treating sampling without replacement as independent trials — when the trials are not independent the binomial model cannot be used.
MAM12 数学方法/U4 · 对数函数/对数定义为指数：aˣ=b ⇔ x=lo: A logarithm is the inverse operation of an exponential: aˣ=b ⇔ x=log_a b (a>0 and a≠1, b>0), so a^(log_a b)=b and log_a aˣ=x. Converting between exponential and logarithmic form is the first step in solving an exponential equation. The argument must be positive, so always substitute back to check for extraneous roots after solving.
MAM12 数学方法/U4 · 对数函数/对数代数性质：log(xy)、log(: The three laws step multiplication, division and powers down a level: log(xy)=log x+log y, log(x/y)=log x−log y and log(xⁿ)=n·log x; there is also log_a 1=0 and the change-of-base formula log_a b=ln b/ln a. The condition is that all arguments are positive, and failing to see that log(x+y) cannot be split apart is the most common error.
MAM12 数学方法/U4 · 对数函数/对数刻度（logarithmic sc: On a logarithmic scale equal-length intervals represent the same 'multiplicative change' rather than the same difference, which suits quantities spanning several orders of magnitude (earthquake magnitude, sound intensity, pH and so on). When reading such a graph, take logarithms of the scale values first and then look at the slope; reading it with linear-scale intuition would misjudge 1→10→100 as arithmetic growth.
MAM12 数学方法/U4 · 对数函数/用对数解指数方程；代数法与图像法解对数: To solve an exponential equation, take logarithms of both sides or write both sides with the same base, using log(xⁿ)=n·log x to bring the unknown down from the exponent; to solve a logarithmic equation, first combine the terms into a single logarithm and then convert to exponential form. Besides the algebraic method, a graphical method can be used to find the intersection of two curves and obtain an approximate solution. Whichever method is used, check that the arguments are positive and the base is valid.
MAM12 数学方法/U4 · 对数函数/y=log_a x 图像特征、渐近线与: The domain of y=log_a x is x>0, the graph passes through (1,0) and (a,1), and the y-axis is a vertical asymptote; it is increasing for a>1 and decreasing for 0<a<1. To sketch y=log_a(x−c)+b, shift the graph c to the right and b up, which moves the asymptote to x=c and changes the domain to x>c. Common error: treating the asymptote as a horizontal line.
MAM12 数学方法/U4 · 对数函数/自然对数 ln x 与 eˣ 的互逆关: ln x is the logarithm to base e and is the inverse function of eˣ: ln(eˣ)=x and e^(ln x)=x (x>0), the two graphs are symmetric about y=x, and ln 1=0 while ln e=1. Taking logarithms of both sides of a model such as A·e^(kt) linearises it so that the parameters can be found. Note that the argument must be positive.
MAM12 数学方法/U4 · 对数函数/d/dx(ln x)=1/x、∫(1/: The logarithmic function is one of the few whose derivative is simpler than the function itself: d/dx(ln x)=1/x; conversely ∫(1/x)dx=ln x+c (true for x>0, generally written ln|x|+c). With the chain rule, d/dx(ln kx)=1/x, independent of k — a neat point that is often examined.
MAM12 数学方法/U4 · 对数函数/d/dx(ln f(x)) 与 ∫f′: The chain rule gives d/dx(ln f(x))=f′(x)/f(x); conversely, when the numerator is exactly the derivative of the denominator, ∫f′(x)/f(x)dx=ln f(x)+c, and recognising this structure is a key integration technique, often paired with a linear inner function ax+b. Common errors: it cannot be applied directly when the denominator has degree higher than one, and the absolute value is easily omitted.
MAM12 数学方法/U4 · 连续随机变量与正态分布/用相对频率直方图估计连续: Group the data and draw a histogram with bar height equal to 'relative frequency ÷ class width'; the area of each bar is then the relative frequency of that class and the total area is approximately 1, and the finer the class width the closer the shape comes to the true density curve. From this the probability that a continuous random variable lies in an interval can be estimated as an area. Common errors: taking the bar height as the probability, or using frequencies instead of relative frequencies.
MAM12 数学方法/U4 · 连续随机变量与正态分布/概率密度函数 pdf 与: The probability for a continuous random variable is the area under the density function: P(a≤X≤b)=∫ₐᵇf(x)dx, with f(x)≥0 and the integral over the whole axis equal to 1 (which can be used to find an unknown constant k); the cumulative distribution function F(x)=P(X≤x) is the integral of the pdf and, conversely, differentiating F gives the pdf. Key difference: for a continuous variable the probability of a single point is 0.
MAM12 数学方法/U4 · 连续随机变量与正态分布/连续随机变量的期望、方差: For a continuous variable you sum with area as the weight: E(X)=∫x·f(x)dx and Var(X)=∫(x−μ)²f(x)dx=E(X²)−[E(X)]², with the standard deviation as the square root; a calculator can be used to evaluate these. A linear transformation satisfies E(aX+b)=aE(X)+b and σ_Y=|a|σ_X. Common errors: using the wrong limits of integration, or not first solving for k in the pdf.
MAM12 数学方法/U4 · 连续随机变量与正态分布/正态模型适用情境与正态: A normal distribution is completely determined by its mean μ and standard deviation σ: the density curve is symmetric about x=μ, reaches its highest point at μ, has the x-axis as a horizontal asymptote and has points of inflection at μ±σ; the larger σ is, the shorter and wider the curve. Empirically about 68% of the data lies within μ±σ and 95% within μ±2σ. It suits symmetric, single-peaked settings such as natural variation.
MAM12 数学方法/U4 · 连续随机变量与正态分布/标准正态分布；用 CAS: After standardising with Z=(X−μ)/σ you can use the standard normal distribution to find probabilities: on the calculator normCdf(lower bound, upper bound, μ, σ) gives the probability and invNorm(area to the left, μ, σ) works backwards from a probability to a quantile, so for example the 24th percentile corresponds to an area to the left of 0.24. Common error: invNorm only accepts cumulative area to the left, so an upper-tail probability must first be subtracted from 1.
MAM12 数学方法/U4 · 比例的区间估计/随机抽样：总体 / 样本 / 参: The population is the whole set of objects of study and the sample is the part drawn from it; a parameter is an unknown constant describing the population (such as p or μ) and a statistic is a quantity calculated from the sample (such as p̂ or x̄) and used to estimate the parameter; a census surveys the whole population, so it has no sampling error but is costly. Distinguishing parameters from statistics, and confirming that the sampling is random, is the premise of all inference in this chapter.
MAM12 数学方法/U4 · 比例的区间估计/抽样偏差来源：选择偏差、设计缺陷: Common sources of bias: selection bias (the sampling frame itself is skewed), flaws in questionnaire design, interviewer influence, faulty recall and reporting, completion bias, non-response bias, and self-selected samples (voluntary respondents tend to hold more extreme views). In an answer you should name which type the given situation is and explain which way it pushes the estimate.
MAM12 数学方法/U4 · 比例的区间估计/样本比例 p̂ 作为随机变量：均: Treat the sample proportion p̂=X/n as a random variable: its mean is the population proportion p and its standard deviation is √(p(1−p)/n), which decreases as n grows — quadruple n and the standard deviation halves. When p is unknown, substitute p̂. Understanding that 'every sample gives a different p̂' is the basis of the interval estimation that follows.
MAM12 数学方法/U4 · 比例的区间估计/大样本下 p̂ 的近似正态性；中: When n is large enough (usually requiring np and n(1−p) both to be reasonably large), the sampling distribution of p̂ is approximately normal with mean p and standard deviation √(p(1−p)/n), so p̂ can be standardised and probabilities found. The Central Limit Theorem states that the sum (or mean) of a large number of independent, identically distributed random variables approaches normality, regardless of whether the population itself is normal.
MAM12 数学方法/U4 · 比例的区间估计/比例的近似置信区间：p̂ ± z: An approximate confidence interval for a proportion p is p̂ ± z√(p̂(1−p̂)/n), where z is determined by the confidence level (1.645 for 90%, 1.96 for 95%, 2.576 for 99%), and p̂ is substituted when p is unknown. The interpretation must be 'about 95% of such intervals will contain p', not 'there is a 95% probability that p lies in this interval'.
MAM12 数学方法/U4 · 比例的区间估计/误差范围 E = z√(p̂(1: The margin of error E=z√(p̂(1−p̂)/n) is the half-width of the confidence interval: the higher the confidence level the larger z is and the wider the interval; to raise the confidence level and shrink the error at the same time, the only option is a larger sample. Solving E for n gives n=(z/E)²p̂(1−p̂); when p̂ is unknown, 0.5 is the most conservative choice, and the value of n obtained must be rounded up.
MAM12 数学方法/考核与备考资源/校本任务：Topic Test 1（10%: Marks accumulate according to the weight of each item, and missing any one of them directly lowers the total. The three tests advance in coverage: differentiation first, then integration, logarithms and random variables, and finally the normal distribution and sampling estimation; these dates are all marked as tentative on the syllabus, so the teacher's notices are what actually apply.
MAM12 数学方法/考核与备考资源/Investigation：周长固定的烤盘: Part 1 is a report by a group of two: with a fixed internal perimeter and a fixed depth, model three cross-sectional shapes (rectangle, right-angled triangle, composite shape), use differentiation to find the dimensions that maximise the volume, and link the design to one of SDG 2, 9 or 12. It is worth 28 marks in total (4%), of which 24 marks are for modelling and solving, 3 for communication and 1 for the SDG justification.
MAM12 数学方法/考核与备考资源/WACE 外部考试：Section 1 禁: The external exam has two sections: Section One is calculator-free, 50 minutes and 47 marks, worth 35%; Section Two allows a graphics or CAS calculator, 100 minutes and 97 marks, worth 65%, and permits two sheets of handwritten A4 notes, with the formula sheet provided in the exam room. Both sections require working to be shown — questions worth more than 2 marks receive no marks without working.
MAM12 数学方法/考核与备考资源/CAS Manual（46 页）：TI-N: Practise the commands until you can key them in blind: differentiation and integration are in the Calculus menu, normal probabilities use normCdf(lower bound, upper bound, μ, σ), working backwards from a probability to a quantile uses invNorm(area to the left, μ, σ), and confidence intervals for a proportion are under Confidence Intervals in Statistics. Copy the frequently used paths into your notes before the exam.
MAM12 数学方法/考核与备考资源/三大讲义册：1.Differentiati: The three volumes are organised by chapter, each chapter followed by an Exercise and Answers, with Revision Exercises and a Test & Exam Preparation section at the end. When revising, work through the worked examples chapter by chapter and then test yourself with past exam questions; the 'nine formulas' and the Extra Integration Formula in particular must be memorised thoroughly.
MAM12 数学方法/考核与备考资源/历年卷与复习：MAM Past Year: The revision section brings past papers, marking keys and topic frequency tables together: the marking key lists the awarding points step by step and is more worth studying than the answers themselves, while the WACE 2016–2025 frequency table shows how heavily each chapter is examined, making it easy to put the high-frequency content — differentiation techniques, curve sketching, applications of integration and statistical inference — at the front of your revision.
MAM12 数学方法/考核与备考资源/个人栏目：Class Notes（37 页: The class notes are mostly handwritten OneNote ink, so when revising you should reorganise them yourself into a formula list and example cards; for wrong answers in homework and quizzes, label the cause of the error (misremembered formula, misread question, calculation slip) and file them by chapter, since looking at your errors and the worked examples in the notes first is the most efficient approach before an exam.
